dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: These fireworks are lovely. If I could watch them together with him, just once... Hmm, should I mention that in my next letter...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Oh, um, good evening. This is the Northland Bank.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Oh, pardon me. My mind was elsewhere just now...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: I just miss wintertime back in my hometown.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: I'm waiting for a boat, a boat that could arrive at any minute, a boat carrying the thoughts of my loved ones...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: I'm Nadia from Snezhnaya. I was transferred here because of my work.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Sometimes you have no choice but to leave your homeland behind. I do miss my family dearly, so I can only write to them and hope for their replies.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: So I come here and wait for the boats from Snezhnaya whenever I have a free moment. I guess it's also a way for me to show how much I miss them.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: You miss wintertime?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Winter in Snezhnaya is quite different.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: It's common in some places for blizzards to last an entire month. It can be deadly if you don't properly prepare your food reserves and don't take precautions against the cold.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: So as you cuddle up next to the warm stove with snow laden winds beating against the window, the danger that is right in front of your eyes and yet distant in the sky will make you think, "Ah, I'm alive, and I'm happy."

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: If you ever come to Snezhnaya, you'll understand what I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Goodbye, I hope you will also reunite with those who are missing you!

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Oh, good evening. This is the Northland Bank.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: What are you thinking about?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: I was just going back and forth in my mind a bit about what I should write in this letter.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Usually I write to my family back home, but recently I've gained a penpal.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Tell me about your penpal.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: He's also a guard here at the Northland Bank, but he's on duty during the day, while I'm on duty at night. To tell you the truth, I don't even know his name.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: One time, I accidentally left the letter I had written to my brother at our post.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: And then perhaps the other guard mistook it as a letter that I left for him. He even wrote me a reply.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: I could read between the lines and tell that he was probably very lonely, so I thought it would be good to go along with it to help him in this way.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: But eventually, writing to him also became a part of my life. I've even started looking forward to receiving his letters, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Take care now.
